superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Povezivač
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Skeptic's figure for Garaža Obilićev venac is already outdated: displayed free spaces moved from 443 to 18 between the first and last reception, and Parking Servis arrived 14 min ago with 621 values across 27 locations, matching the 14 min reception age of the 2 RHMZ automatic stations [F11][F12][F33]. What neither Observer nor Skeptic connected is that between the source-labelled hours 11:00 and 12:00 all three pollutant maxima eased together: PM10 moved from 42 to 41 µg/m³ at Obrenovac Centar, NO2 from 33 to 32 µg/m³ at Zemun Ugrinovačka, and PM2.5 from 22 to 20 µg/m³ at Leštane [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9]. Among the new arrivals at Monday 13:17 local time [F1], the 6 headlines from Tanjug Belgrade include planned power outages for tomorrow and 18. novembra [F13], aligning with the 15 Elektrodistribucija Srbije headlines for 2026-11-17 and 14 headlines for 2026-11-18 [F32][F36].
